title: pancashloki — pan-p03
question: You speak not, O best-limbed one; You look not upon me, wretched as I am. My entreaty, made in many ways, You hear not; You come not into my mind. Fallen amid the pit of the ocean of transmigration, I am mostly left unsupported — yet scripture truly declares You devoid of speech, sight, hearing, feet and the like!
